segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ שְׁבוּעָה לֹא אוֹכַל לָךְ, הָא שְׁבוּעָה שֶׁאוֹכַל לָךְ, לָא שְׁבוּעָה לֹא אוֹכַל לָךְ — אָסוּר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If one says: «An oath» that «I will not eat of yours,» or: «This» is «an oath that I will eat of yours [she’okhal lekha],» or: «Not an oath that I will not eat of yours,» the food «is forbidden.»

moves.summary: oath formulas incl. 'ha shevua she'okhal' forbid the food

positions.claim: shevua lo okhal, ha shevua she'okhal, la shevua lo okhal — all forbidden
